prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic scene set in a spacious, sunlit industrial warehouse with high ceilings and large, gridded windows letting in soft, natural daylight. In the foreground, two stylish motorcycles are parked side by side, their chrome and matte finishes gleaming under the diffused light. Three people are the focus: a woman with curly hair, dressed in a black leather jacket, dark jeans, and boots, stands confidently between the bikes, holding a helmet in one hand and reaching out with the other to grasp the hand of a man. The man, also in a leather jacket and casual attire, stands beside one of the motorcycles, engaging with the woman in a moment of camaraderie or encouragement. To the right, another man in a leather jacket and jeans is putting on a red and white helmet, preparing for a ride. The mood is adventurous and energetic, with a sense of anticipation and friendship. The color palette is muted and earthy, dominated by blacks, grays, and metallic tones, with subtle pops of color from the helmets and clothing. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to keep the subjects sharply in focus against the softly blurred industrial background, evoking a modern, cinematic style reminiscent of a road movie or motorcycle adventure film.
